newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary o/n market liquid, rates continue to drop.
newsitem.headline: Hungary o/n market liquid, rates continue to drop.

text.p: Hungary's overnight money market remained abundant in funds and the overnight rates continued the past few days' declining trend on Friday, dealers said.
The overnight rates closed at 21.5/21.625 percent, compared with Thursday's finish of 21.625/22.00.
"It was a passive market wit the trend downwards," said Jozsef Bodor of West LB Hungaria.
Dealers said earlier rates were likely to rise next week as banks keep their funds for Monday's corporate tax payments.
